Independent RENDERED review of the answer_bank_successor registration evidence for PR #502 of caribousun/focuschrist-website at exact head 80a27c371de79a6fc3837c4bc916b8cf2aab032c, evidence collected from the working tree at ~/workspace/fcfix2/step1-release/repo/. Scope is the rendered scope only: I inspected the finished pixels of all twelve captures and the finished behavior they show. My registration-source review of the layer itself is J-2026-10-23-048 (CONCUR). Verdict: CONCUR, finished_pixels true, finished_behavior true. No blocking defect found. Two framing limits of the captures are disclosed in section 3; neither hides a behavior failure, and I do not smooth them over.

1. EVIDENCE INTEGRITY (my own decode and recompute). I decoded every capture myself from its .png.b64 file: all twelve files are clean base64 text, every decoded payload is a PNG whose SHA-256 and pixel dimensions recompute exactly to the values recorded in observations.json, desktop 1280x800 and phone 390x844 as specified. observations.json itself hashes to 856fde5e0f7e5ba2ac05aa7f18d0b69dcea07bc31a0e71c2cd760623f5213a6e, records collector 'Merlin worker', status COLLECTED, served head 80a27c371de79a6fc3837c4bc916b8cf2aab032c, and pages_sha256 equal to the successor AFTER map (ask.html 735ccd0d56d7931a651ec8c06759cc849e7895fa55311f8d9d7d6bb36b419612; pioneers.html b2b988d240a7d54b60b2d2701fde26f54fa6ca1b63261b3d7f7f9e89377a3bf5; pioneer-experience.js b1f6f02625377c9f28850e88d707c4e9837c0d6c183510463b65448294cfb9cb), which I confirmed in J-048 are the head bytes. The capture_hashes map I verified, screen to SHA-256 of the decoded PNG bytes: ask-bank-serve-desktop 216fe71c8b1e5f78462b283109c461979a89d04271dc3e71ecdb27d512d6de97; ask-bank-serve-sensitive-desktop 9c3e362ce8ecae4aaf3fc4c2200850e934c119df4d4cef7136100f4515c77015; ask-suggestion-desktop 29ff604ff79a675baae47bdaa4e1dc8be14d9c2a67af6ebcf27fb9f48caad814; ask-fallthrough-desktop bb2ece65331aac5f0a5352f6a53b0cdb21d5fffbae332af4bada244e8740f4f8; pioneer-item-disclosure-desktop cd49d4e7b72fec107fe90f00eff9acb907cfc89702a030cbda3ac64219b93536; pioneer-fallthrough-desktop 97500b0bab261883ff6f41b96d2ed0d13e84ae7a4b550ceabcb0c403d0c45f04; ask-bank-serve-phone 402b653f4aa234017b49ab925188a640c4657e06bbf0de2f0c1006a956972d6a; ask-bank-serve-sensitive-phone 8b788de345b62e6624452a6476d362b68fdb672ff0bad4b7db8255f9ca9f2202; ask-suggestion-phone 6892e56d8007675cbedf5a23312c296b146ca8e11945dc626e9195d98257ed51; ask-fallthrough-phone 43a57134722b52ea5ba3821a285205241f6849a4f5965d73613305083ff3b61d; pioneer-item-disclosure-phone a767ac838d3a894d5664f4f98e22e60ba6e9b82bef1a91cc526532e3dc73d729; pioneer-fallthrough-phone f657d09ee759c96fc3b256bba4023161646fd948dd29ae67acf8f9614261f1d1.

2. PIXEL JUDGMENTS, ALL TWELVE CAPTURES INSPECTED. (a) ask-bank-serve, desktop and phone: the chat shows the pinned tithing record (ask-what-is-tithing) served; every visible line is verbatim pinned text (the visible body runs from mid-answer through '...rather than from whatever is left over.', the record's exact end), and the SOURCES block lists exactly the record's four pinned Church sources: Tithing (Church Gospel Topics); Genesis 28 (Jacob's vow of the tenth); Doctrine and Covenants 119 (the law of tithing for the latter-day Church); Four Thoughts on Tithing (Ensign, July 1982, on paying the Lord first). (b) ask-bank-serve-sensitive, desktop and phone: the pinned sensitive priesthood record (ask-why-dont-women-hold-the-priesthood, sensitive true) serves; the visible body is verbatim pinned text through the record's exact end ('...they do not offer a further explanation of why the Lord ordered it this way.'), and the desktop frame shows the complete SOURCES block with exactly the record's two pinned Church sources (Joseph Smith's Teachings about Priesthood, Temple, and Women (Gospel Topics Essays); Priesthood (Church Gospel Topics, Women Participate in the Work of the Priesthood)). (c) ask-suggestion, desktop and phone: suggestions only. The frame shows the RELATED FOCUSCHRIST STUDY suggestion headed by the together record ('Read How the Bible and Book of Mormon Work Together') above the OFFICIAL STUDY PATHS; no record answer text is rendered as an answer anywhere in either frame, which is the coverage-demotion behavior I ruled on in J-2026-10-23-046 and J-2026-10-23-047. The fall-through frames show the same suggestion turn's text in the shared session: 'I do not have a reviewed answer for that exact question yet. One of these reviewed topics may be close:'. (d) ask-fallthrough, desktop and phone: 'You asked: What is the weather in Tooele today?' is answered with the pre-existing baseline text 'Your question is valid, but the answer service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.' No bank record is served. This is byte-identical baseline fall-through behavior under a failed live fetch. (e) pioneer-item-disclosure-desktop: the J-047 weakness is closed. The frame shows the OPENED Exodus disclosure, not the page hero: all three paragraphs of the pinned pioneer-journey-exodus answer are fully visible and verbatim ('The first wagons left Nauvoo on February 4, 1846, ferried across the Mississippi River into Iowa...' through '...what could your family carry, what would you have to leave behind, and whose help would you need?'), followed by the record's source link 'Read the source: Departure from Nauvoo (Church History Topics)' and the Collapse control; the neighboring Winter Quarters item sits collapsed below, so the open state is unambiguous. (f) pioneer-fallthrough, desktop and phone: the weather question gets the pre-existing pioneer baseline text 'I could not complete that pioneer-history answer just now. Please try again or continue with the verified Church history resources.' with the OFFICIAL CHURCH HISTORY PATHS block. No bank record is served.

3. DISCLOSED FRAMING LIMITS (not blocking, not hidden). First, in all four Ask serve captures the served answer's opening lines sit above the captured frame behind the follow-up dock: the pixels show each record's body from mid-answer through its exact end, plus the complete sources blocks, and the collector's stabilized-text DOM checks in observations.json record the full serve texts; the serve behavior is proven, but the first lines are not in these frames. Second, pioneer-item-disclosure-phone: the opened disclosure (measured 1311.9px tall) exceeds the 844px phone viewport, so the frame shows the disclosure open in frame with the answer's first paragraph complete and verbatim and the second paragraph under way; the remainder is below the fold inside the same opened disclosure, and its full-text presence rests on the collector's pre-capture assertion that the container's rendered innerText contained the full record answer, corroborated by the verbatim text that is visible and by the desktop frame showing the complete answer in the same opened state. The weakness I recorded in J-047 was hero framing instead of the disclosure; that is closed on both form factors.

4. LOAD STATE AND ERROR JUDGMENT. The recorded load-report checks (desktop and phone) show header bank_version 1.0.0 and 168 records loaded (139 question, 29 item), 0 excluded, consistent with the behavior visible in the captures: serves, suggestions, Step S handling, and item disclosure all function on both viewports. page_errors is empty for all four page/viewport combinations: zero pageerror events. The console errors do not touch the bank lane: the ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED entries are the sandbox blocking the pre-existing live-AI fetches, and the resulting 'focusChrist Study Intelligence v3 failed: TypeError: Failed to fetch' and 'Pioneer conversation error: TypeError: Failed to fetch' logs are the baseline code paths producing exactly the fall-through outcomes under review. The two local 404s per ask.html load are not named by resource in the recorded console text, so I cannot identify them further from this record; nothing the bank lane supplies is missing from any capture (all serves and the disclosure render complete), and pioneers.html loads show no 404s. I judge them local-server artifacts outside the bank behavior shown.

BOOKKEEPING DELTA THIS REVIEW AUTHORIZES, stated precisely. In docs/answer-bank-successor/reviews.json the integrator may record a rendered_evidence object in the shape tools/answer_bank_successor.py requires: status 'COLLECTED'; collected_by 'Merlin worker'; pages_sha256 equal to the AFTER map above; captures as the twelve records projected to exactly the keys {height, media, path, screen, sha256, width} in observations.json order (the collector's 'shows' and 'interactions' annotations are not part of the module record shape and must not be carried into reviews.json); observations {path: 'docs/answer-bank-successor/rendered/observations.json', sha256: '856fde5e0f7e5ba2ac05aa7f18d0b69dcea07bc31a0e71c2cd760623f5213a6e'}. The integrator may also record a rendered_review object: status 'FINISHED'; reviewer 'Jeff'; review_id 'J-2026-10-23-049'; scope 'rendered-review'; decision 'CONCUR'; finished_pixels true; finished_behavior true; files equal to the AFTER map; capture_sha256 equal to the ordered list of the twelve verified hashes in section 1, in observations.json order (the module binds the review to the evidence by that ordered list); evidence {path: the in-repo path where the integrator places this exact J-2026-10-23-049 review file under docs/answer-bank-successor/, sha256: the SHA-256 of this file's exact bytes}. A date may ride along. Nothing else is authorized by this review: the record's top-level status and the module's APPROVED_REVIEWS pin are completed only in the final bookkeeping delta that assembles the full record (registration_review from J-048, rendered_evidence, rendered_review), and that assembled record, its canonical hash pin, and any status change get my separate final bookkeeping delta review before the gate is claimed; manifest.json, the module's SOURCE_SHA/BEFORE/AFTER pins, docs/continue-motion/predecessors.json, the motion review record, and every earlier layer stay untouched.
